title: The Thunderclaps of Haxelgrim
story: Above the shepherds' valley, Haxelgrim the Trebling Sleet Sprite hovers in a bruise-colored cloud with two grinning hailstone-golems at her side. Every thunderclap she makes causes each hailstone-golem to split into three. Mr 6 counts on his fingers instead of charging, because he knows exactly how many claps it takes her to tire out: four.
question: After all four thunderclaps, how many hailstone-golems will there be?
solution: Start with 2 golems; each clap triples the count.
After the fourth clap there are 162 hailstone-golems.
praise: Tripling over and over was the right plan — it just needed one more round of ×3 to reach the fourth clap.
hint: Don't multiply 2 by 3 and 4 together — triple the whole crowd once for each clap, one clap at a time.
victory: Mr 6 holds up a funnel-shaped shepherd's horn sized for exactly 162 hailstones, and the whole trebling swarm clatters inside like dice in a cup. Haxelgrim, suddenly golem-less, floats off to sulk in a smaller cloud.
imagePrompt: A caped numeral-six knight stands on a green hillside holding a huge funnel-horn as a storm sprite in a purple thundercloud multiplies dozens of glittering ice golems above him, dramatic lightning-lit sky.
